## About
Karl's Collision Repair is a paint and auto body shop in Glendale, Arizona. We specialize in fine automobiles, and we have the facilities to take on any paint or collision repair job.
Damaged parts are replaced with OEM parts, structural pieces are welded to factory specifications, and paint is mixed with BASF's color matching system and baked in a downdraft paint booth. Every vehicle is detailed and inspected before it goes home.
One reviewer called us a mom and pop operation, and that's how we like to run things. We're open Monday through Friday and work with all insurance companies.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Full service body repair for cars and trucks after an accident.
- Paint work: Paint is mixed by computer and baked to a factory quality finish, and the paint work carries a lifetime warranty. One reviewer said his paint matched perfectly.
- Computerized frame measuring: Frame checks using a Shark computerized measuring system.
- Rental car arrangements: We can help line up a rental while your vehicle is in the shop.
- Headlight re-sealing: One reviewer had his headlights re-sealed and said they came out clear.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and one reviewer said we took care of all the insurance details for him.

Q: Is there a warranty on the work?
A: You receive a limited lifetime warranty. If there's a defect in materials or workmanship, bring the vehicle back and we'll fix it at no charge.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Fill out our appointment form and choose estimate or repair. We'll get back to you as soon as possible, or you can call us.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

At the higher end, he offered a complete rebuild which would have provided a far stronger than original new equipment and yet equally light-weight option. Bob recommended that I actually see the trailer back when he opened it up, so he could better discuss the options. He gave me details of how he would make the repair. He got on the job quickly, yet allowed proper time for each step to complete – such as allowing the glue to fully set before moving to the next step.
